newsitem.title: FRANCE: France arrests suspected ETA leader.
newsitem.headline: France arrests suspected ETA leader.

text.p: France arrested a suspected leader of the Basque separatist group ETA on Tuesday, police sources said.

Juan Luis Aguirre Lete, also known as Isuntza, was seized by customs agents in the Landes area of southwest France after a car chase along a highway near Benesse-Maremne. He had tried to drive past a customs check set up at a toll booth.
He was placed in detention by police in the nearby city of Bayonne. ETA, (Basque Homeland and Freedom), have killed nearly 800 people in a drive for full independence which began in 1968.
